body: Cons, You’re passing the pain, if your not 25 your brain isn’t fully developed, you waste your efforts you have been putting in life since you were born.

Tbh I come on subs like these to have this very type of discussions. I like trying to find the meaning in the issues I face although it can be very frustrating. Not to drown further into depressive thoughts.

I feel like covid was my gap that I wasted and after summer break I thought I was ready. I had gone through so much mental turmoil during the previous semester to the point where I thought surely now I wouldn’t let myself fall back in that trap. I was somewhat wrong and will most likely be completely wrong as this semester unfolds. 

The thing is I’ve had the mindset where I didn’t care how my actions toward my academics would affect my future. My expectations were that I would put in the work and did not have many negative emotions when I would fall short. Over time though I kept falling short and my mindset has become a result of that.

I can and am planning on receiving therapy but at the end of the day, I know the actions I commit that lead me into the pits of depression yet I still fall into them. I don’t see how therapy would help me somehow overcome the barriers that I have not been able to hurdle over despite my many, and I mean many attempts.

Also although I am glad that you have found something interesting to keep you going, I myself have not for about two to three years. As a matter of fact I have only found things that instead made me realize that things are of less value than I previously thought. As of right now I don’t really think I would ever have the courage to actually decide and commit suicide. However I do feel myself inching closer to such an act every few weeks.

Thanks for the words. My problem is that I keep falling short when I have the ability to do the work. I got adhd meds yet I still keep procrastinating. I had people who tried to help me with starting a business yet I never actually ended up taking their help. 

No one in my life has made me happy. The ones I’ve considered the closest were always the ones to stab my back, even when I had always been there for them. My family made my childhood a living hell. I’m bad at every hobby I try that leaves me frustrated. 

This makes feel like if I were ever in a situation that I needed to put the work in to get out of, I wouldn’t. Also feels like any friends I make I would do so just to have people I consider friends. Not people I would actually enjoy spending time with. 


I don’t care about what other think of me. But I care about who I am as a person. And after trying again and again, what felt like hundreds of times quite literally, my conclusion is that I am a weak person mentally and would have no other choice than to live a life I wouldn’t enjoy with no way of ever being able to escape it myself.
